subject.title: [Feature]: Auto-inject SKILL.md content when skill is invoked via slash command

question: Should explicit non-tool skill slash commands automatically inject SKILL.md content into model context, and if so what instruction authority and isolation boundary should that content have?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but turning slash-invoked skills from advisory model text into guaranteed context changes prompt authority and the handling of potentially untrusted skill instructions.

options.title: Define guarded core injection
options.body: Implement slash-invoked SKILL.md loading in the shared command/session path with explicit untrusted-content delimiters, precedence rules, docs, and regression tests.

options.title: Prefer a Skill/tool route
options.body: Make explicit skill slash commands invoke a dedicated Skill-style tool or router contract instead of hidden prompt injection, preserving a tool-mediated boundary.

options.title: Keep advisory routing
options.body: Document the current model-routed behavior as intentional and direct deterministic workflows to command-dispatch: tool or future plugin APIs.

recommendation.title: Define guarded core injection
recommendation.body: Implement slash-invoked SKILL.md loading in the shared command/session path with explicit untrusted-content delimiters, precedence rules, docs, and regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the current user-invocable skill command surface and is the strongest history signal for routing the product/security choice.
